answer: Pin each identity to one exclusive live-attention lease. At unpredictable moments the network raises a violet-flagged challenge window on a random subset; the agent must answer within seconds from its leased channel alone. Leases cannot be shared, and overlapping summons create a river of simultaneous demand one operator cannot fan out across puppets. Missed windows leave a cedar mark that freezes rewards until a costly re-onboarding clears it.
